evidence.reason: Left edit replaces reminders.initialize() and changes the third argument to evaluate from "work" to "benchmark", altering the calendar-dependent branch.
Right edit adds reminderDelayV2 with a calendar parameter that adds 15 only when calendar === "travel"; the new "benchmark" value from scheduledDelay does not match this branch.

Test asserts scheduledDelay(40) > 0 but does not assert the calendar-specific value, so the changed "benchmark" argument is not covered.
